brief.headline: Banks line up €550m in loans for KKR’s Logoplaste buyout
bullets: M&A & Buyouts: A group of banks has arranged €550m in loans to back KKR’s acquisition of Portuguese packaging manufacturer Logoplaste from Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan, in a deal that could value the business at more than €1.2bn, according to a report by Bloomberg.
Fundraising: Invesco Real Estate has closed Invesco Real Estate Asia Fund V with $1.35 billion of total commitments, its largest closed-end fundraise for the region.
Hedge Funds: Bridgewater's machine-learning fund, AIA Macro, launched in July 2024 with almost $2bn and now runs over $4.5bn.

AI & Technology: Regulated enterprises can now buy LigaData's data and governed AI through Google Cloud and run them wherever their data strategy requires, from the cloud to sovereign on-premises environments with LigaData's Barq Citadel.
Fundraising: GEF Capital Partners has raised $615 million at the first close of South Asia Growth Fund IV.
brief.marketRead: Bottom line: signals are mixed, with some markets calm and others showing strain, so expect selective risk-taking. items.title: New York pension fund weighs $4bn financing backed by private credit stakes
